cards.mood: The piece opens with a fragile, intimate atmosphere that gradually builds into a soaring, anthemic plea during the choruses.
cards.vocal: A single male vocalist delivers the performance with a clear, smooth tenor timbre that carries a distinct breathy quality, enhancing the song's sense of vulnerability.
cards.palette: An acoustic guitar serves as the harmonic backbone throughout the entire track, utilizing a rhythmic strumming pattern that evolves from sparse picking in the intro to full, driving strums in the choruses.
